name: csv_json
description: Convert between CSV and a JSON array (AssemblyScript), quoted fields and embedded commas/newlines handled per RFC 4180. WHEN TO USE: a tool or the user handed you CSV and you need it as structured data, or vice versa. Input: {"csv": "..."} (first row is the header; each following row becomes a {header: value} object) or {"json": "..."} (an array of objects, union of keys becomes the header row, or an array of arrays written as rows with no header). Direction is inferred from which field is set; pass "mode": "to_json"|"to_csv" to be explicit.
llm_description: Convert CSV <-> JSON array (RFC 4180 quoting). {csv} (header row -> {header:value} objects) or {json} (array of objects -> CSV with union-of-keys header, or array of arrays -> rows with no header). mode?:'to_json'|'to_csv' to disambiguate when both could apply.

csv.description: CSV text to convert to a JSON array.

json.description: A JSON array (of objects or of arrays) to convert to CSV.

mode.description: to_json or to_csv. Inferred from which of csv/json is set if omitted.
